Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a tuition surcharge for international students.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a surcharge on tuition fees charged tointernational students; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.15 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning in the 201314 academic year, the governing boards of thestate universities, the regional universities, The Evergreen StateCollege, and the community and technical colleges must include a twentypercent surcharge on tuition fees for nonresident undergraduate orgraduate students who hold lawful nonimmigrant status pursuant to 8U.S.C. Sec. 1101 (a)(15)(F) or (J). The revenue from the surchargemust be deposited in the general fund.
